plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the single name mandate.
Reduce CRWD to 10% to further diversify and manage single name risk.
Buy ADI at 5% as a top-quality long setup to add diversification.
This plan prioritizes capital preservation and reduces overall portfolio risk.
conservative.read: This conservative plan targets a modest ~1.5%/month return, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and lowering concentration. Expect lower volatility and drawdowns, but also more limited upside potential.

plan: Trim SOXL to 3% and SPAL to 2% to reduce leveraged ETF exposure.
Reduce SPY to 25% to meet the single name concentration mandate.
Buy ADI at 4% to add a quality tech name to the portfolio.
This plan balances risk and growth, maintaining a diversified approach.
balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for ~2.5%/month growth, prioritizing risk management while seeking returns. It reduces leverage and concentration, blending broad index exposure with quality tech. Expect moderate volatility and drawdowns, with reasonable growth potential.

plan: Trim SPY to 25% to meet the single name concentration mandate.
Add to SOXL and SPAL, increasing leveraged ETF exposure to 6% each.
Buy ADI at 6% and ZS at 4% to concentrate in high-scoring scanner setups.
This plan leans into leverage and concentration for aggressive growth.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4%/month growth, accepting significantly higher risk. It increases leveraged ETF exposure and concentrates in high-scoring setups. Be aware of amplified drawdowns, daily leverage decay, and the potential for rapid losses if stops are hit.

plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure.
Sell CRWD to zero to reduce high-beta single name exposure.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the single name mandate.
Add to QQQI, increasing its allocation to 30% for steady monthly distributions.
This plan prioritizes low drawdown and reliable income over growth.
income.read: This income plan targets ~1%/month, focusing on steady monthly distributions and low drawdown. It significantly reduces leverage and high-beta names, rotating into income-generating ETFs. Remember, distributions are variable, and NAV can still fall in market selloffs.
